title: When, Where, and What to Correct: Human-Guided Adaptive Residual Correction for Robot Policies
abstract: arXiv:2610.37547v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Imitation policies that reliably execute most of a manipulation trajectory can still fail in localized regions requiring last-mile precision. Updating the full policy or exploring residual actions everywhere treats this local failure as a global learning problem. We introduce Adaptive Residual Correction (ARC), a lightweight post-training module that uses reinforcement learning (RL) to learn a residual correction on top of a frozen policy while using sparse human corrections to structure autonomous exploration. Rather than treating human corrections as imitation targets, ARC uses pre-intervention states to determine 'when' residual control should become active and correction geometry to determine 'where' in residual action space autonomous refinement should explore; task reward determines 'what' residual is ultimately executed. Across three precision-manipulation tasks on a real robot, ARC improves average task success from 33.3% to 75

translated_title: 何时、何地以及修正什么：面向机器人策略的人类引导自适应残差修正
translated_abstract: 能够可靠执行操作轨迹大部分内容的模仿学习策略，仍可能在需要“最后一英里”精度的局部区域失败。更新整个策略或在所有地方探索残差动作，是将这种局部失败当作全局学习问题来处理。我们提出了自适应残差修正（ARC），这是一个轻量级的后训练模块，它使用强化学习（RL）在冻结策略之上学习残差修正，同时利用稀疏的人类修正来组织自主探索。ARC并不将人类修正视为模仿目标，而是利用干预前状态来确定残差控制“何时”应被激活，利用修正几何来确定自主细化应在残差动作空间的“何处”进行探索；任务奖励则决定最终执行“什么”残差。在真实机器人上的三项精密操作任务中，ARC将平均任务成功率从33.3%提升至75
tldr: 提出轻量级后训练模块ARC，利用强化学习在冻结策略之上学习残差修正，并通过稀疏人类修正确定残差控制激活的“时机”与自主探索的“方向”，将真实机器人精密操作任务的平均成功率从33.3%提升至75%。
en_tdlr: ARC is a lightweight post-training module that uses reinforcement learning to learn residual corrections atop a frozen policy, leveraging sparse human corrections to determine when residual control activates and where autonomous exploration should refine, boosting average real-robot precision-manipulation success from 33.3% to 75%.
